issue.question: How can the source-bound report receive its declared controller product binding when the recorded repair envelope proposed no products?
issue.exact_missing_or_defect: The recorded R37 repair envelope CONTROLLER_RESULT_VALIDATED_cull00vg.json omits qualified_products. research_controller.py lines 2607-2611 defaults that field to [] and stores candidate_products=[]. Live R37-00-FIRST-REPORT therefore has candidate_products=[] for candidate sha256:d6d466298749d7ee4c3683305c7315b845aacef0c6b9bbc37085d67c1b6c87ee despite spec.qualified_product_expected=convergence_baseline_report. The review gate at lines 2594-2599 requires reviewed qualified_products to be a subset of candidate_products. Returning the report product would be rejected; recording success with no product would leave the declared downstream product dependency unavailable.
